title: We've Now Found 40,000 Asteroids Near Earth
hook: Space just got a lot less empty.
source: NASA Center for Near-Earth Object Studies (CNEOS) and ESA's Planetary Defence Office milestone announcements: the 10,000th near-Earth object was catalogued in June 2013, the 30,000th in October 2022, and the 40,000th in November 2025. Earlier and intermediate-year totals are conservative estimates interpolated from the discovery-rate curve published in those releases. Potentially Hazardous Asteroid (PHA) counts are approximate running totals from the same catalogues, which track PHAs as a subset of all catalogued near-Earth asteroids.
